Delhi Police arrested five persons in separate cases for the illegal sale and storage of firecrackers in north-east Delhi, recovering 91.9 kg of fireworks, officials said on Saturday.
The cases were registered at Jyoti Nagar, Shastri Park, and Dayalpur police stations as part of a district-wide crackdown on unauthorised firecrackers.
Three of the five persons were caught under the jurisdiction of the Jyoti Nagar police station. The police recovered 26 kg of uncertified firecrackers, including sky shots and bombs, from Sunay Kumar (42) at Ashok Nagar Market. A QR-code verification confirmed the items were not certified green crackers. In the same area, Atul (20) was caught with 13 kg of illegal firecrackers, while Khem Chand (54) was apprehended near Mangal Bazar with 22 kg.
In Shastri Park, a police team acting on a tip-off raided a local venue and caught Awadhesh (50) with two plastic sacks containing 20.36 kg of illegal fireworks. Meanwhile, a patrolling team from the Dayalpur police station caught Yasin (40) selling 10.55 kg of firecrackers without a licence in Nehru Vihar.
None of the five persons possessed a valid licence and the police said that none had a prior criminal record, official said. Five separate FIRs have been registered and further investigation is under way, they added.
